description: This Swift source file defines a speech processing pipeline that integrates AVFoundation and Speech frameworks to handle live microphone input, perform speech analysis and transcription, and stream speech segments with text and finality status. It includes structures, enums, and an actor class managing the asynchronous flow of speech recognition.

classes.name: SpeechSegment
classes.description: A simple data structure representing a segment of recognized speech, including text and whether it is the final segment.

classes.name: SpeechPipelineError
classes.description: An enum defining possible errors during speech processing, such as authorization denial or unavailable analyzers.

classes.name: SpeechPipeline
classes.description: An actor managing the live speech recognition pipeline, handling audio input, analysis, transcription, and streaming of speech segments.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition pipeline with specified locale and etiquette options, returning an asynchronous stream of speech segments.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the speech recognition pipeline, cancelling tasks, removing audio tap, stopping the engine, and finalizing analysis.

methods.name: handleBuffer
methods.description: Converts incoming audio buffers to the required format and feeds them into the analysis pipeline.

methods.name: requestAuthorizationIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks and requests speech recognition authorization if not already granted.
